bumper.definition: An eye-catching graphic/text element used to highlight product or service benefits, discounts, or similar promotional messages.
bumper.primary_role: Create visual emphasis and quick recognition of a key message in a layout.

label_or_seal.definition: A visual highlight element used to emphasize relevant information and convey additional values such as trust or quality.
label_or_seal.primary_role: Spark interest, communicate additional value, and support recognizability, especially for guarantees.
label_or_seal.difference_from_bumper: Labels and seals may be designed in greater detail than bumpers, including multiple font sizes, color gradations, icons, and additional graphic elements.

principles.description: Bumpers, labels, and seals should visually stand out and attract attention without compromising brand consistency.
Text should be brief and to the point. Bumper text should not exceed approximately 15 characters per line.
Designed bumpers, labels, and seals should use Bosch accent colors and neutral base colors according to the defined rules.
All applications must provide enough contrast. Text and graphic elements should remain readable on images, products, or neutral backgrounds.

sections.title: Text bumpers
sections.description: Text bumpers are especially suitable for displaying product or service benefits, discounts, or anything similar because of their eye-catching effect.

types.title: Round text bumpers

color_rules.standard_version: Use one of the four Bosch accent colors as the bumper background, with text set in white.
color_rules.inverted_version: Use a neutral Bosch base color as the background for inverted versions.
allowed_backgrounds: Neutral Bosch base colors for inverted versions

layout_rules.rotation: Counterclockwise rotation by 10 degrees is used/allowed.
placement: Directly on a product image for maximum exposure
layout_rules.copy_style: Brief, direct, and to the point.

annotations: Bosch Sans Regular and Bosch Sans Bold.
Inverted version on neutral base color.

usage_notes: Place directly on the image, on a neutral background, or directly on the product image to create maximum exposure in the layout.
Bumper text should not contain more than approximately 15 characters per line.
The wording should be brief and to the point.

sections.title: Labels and seals
sections.description: Labels and seals visually highlight relevant information, spark interest, and convey additional values such as trust or quality.
design_features: Can be designed in greater detail than bumpers.
May use color gradations when allowed by the specific type rule.
May include additional graphic elements such as icons.
Graphic elements help provide stability and recognizability.

types.title: Round labels and seals

color_rules.standard_version: Create each round label or seal in one of the four Bosch accent colors.
color_rules.gradations: All gradations can be used as long as enough contrast is provided.
color_rules.inverted_version: Inverted versions can be used on neutral base colors.

graphic_rules.icons: Icons may be used to convey information quickly and effectively.
graphic_rules.additional_graphics: Additional graphic elements can help provide stability.
graphic_rules.seal_character: Lines or text set in a circular pattern can create a familiar seal character and improve recognizability.

annotations: Use of gradations within an accent color.
Icons convey information fast and effectively.
Additional, graphic elements can help to provide stability.
Inverted versions on neutral base color.

color_rules.standard_version: Customized rectangular labels and seals are rendered in one of the four Bosch accent colors.
color_rules.inverted_version: Inverted versions on a neutral base color are possible.
color_rules.external_sources: Seals and labels from external sources use their respective original colors.

layout_rules.placement: Position at one of the four corners of the format.
layout_rules.text_length: No more than approximately 15 characters per line.
layout_rules.icons: Icons may be included to support the text.

usage_notes: Icons help convey textual information more efficiently.
Other elements, such as lines or circular text, create a familiar seal character and support recognizability.

rules.rule: Text boxes and rectangular labels must not sit together on the same image.
rules.rationale: Avoid visual clutter and conflicting highlight systems.

rules.rule: The label must stand out from the background and must not contain transparency.
rules.rationale: Ensure legibility and strong visual emphasis.

rules.rule: Designed labels use only Bosch base and accent colors and do not contain gradients.

resources.title: Templates for bumpers and labels
resources.description: Downloadable templates for bumpers and labels.

when_to_use_bumpers: Use when the message is short and promotional or benefit-oriented.
Use when quick visual attention is needed in a layout.
when_to_use_labels_or_seals: Use when the information conveys trust, quality, guarantee, or additional value.
Use when more visual detail is needed than a simple bumper allows.
generation_constraints: Keep text concise, ideally no more than approximately 15 characters per line.
Use Bosch accent colors or neutral base colors as specified by element type.
Do not combine text boxes and rectangular labels on the same image.
